snippet.title: The Raven and the Light - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
The Raven and the Light is a short story-driven horror game taking place in a dark time in Canada's recent past. The Raven and the Light is free and available for PC, Mac, and Linux!

Play the game!

http://gamejolt.com/games/the-raven-and-the-light/105061
